help.stdout:
Usage: otlv dump|validate|decode --format NAME [--input PATH|- | --hex BYTES] [OPTIONS]
       otlv generate --format NAME --seed N --count N --output-dir PATH [OPTIONS]
       otlv encode --format NAME --tag HEX [--value HEX] [--output-encoding hex|binary]
       otlv encode --format NAME [--input JSON_PATH|-] [--output-encoding hex|binary] [--output-file PATH]
       otlv query PATH --format NAME [--input PATH|- | --hex BYTES] [--value] [--output text|json]
       otlv query --query EXPR --format NAME [--var NAME:TYPE=VALUE] [--count|--exists] [--backend auto|streaming|document] [--explain]
       otlv diff --format NAME --input LEFT --against RIGHT [--where EXPR] [--output text|json]
       otlv tag HEX --module emv [--output text|json]
       otlv tags --module emv [--search TEXT] [--output text|json]
       otlv completion bash|zsh|fish|powershell
       otlv formats | --help | --version
Formats: fixed, ber, der, emv, bluetooth-ltv, nfc-type2 (when enabled in this build)
Options:
  --fixed-tag-size N     --format fixed: tag width in bytes (default 1)
  --fixed-length-size N  --format fixed: length width in bytes, 1..8 (default 1)
  --fixed-byte-order NAME --format fixed: length byte order, big (default) or little
  --pdol                 Read raw DOL tag/one-byte-length pairs (BER)
  --tree                 Print nested BER/DER elements (dump only)
  --pretty               Print a graphical UTF-8 tree (implies --tree)
  --module emv           Annotate BER tags (dump, decode) or check EMV data (validate)
  --describe             Include EMV type and length descriptions
  --module bluetooth     Annotate Bluetooth AD types; validate schema and codecs
  --decode               Decode known values (requires --module emv or bluetooth)
  --emv-context NAME     EMV dictionary context of the top-level elements: base (default), bit, bht, bht-format, bit-group, biometric-counters, biometric-attempts, biometric-verification
  --emv-check NAME       validate: structure (default), dictionary or all
  --recover              dump, decode: skip damaged bytes and keep reading; the output is marked incomplete and the exit code is 4
  --output text|json     Print text (default) or a hierarchical JSON document
  --diagnostics NAME     Shape of a failure diagnostic: human (default), compact or json
  --input-encoding NAME  binary (default) or hex, for --input
  --force-color          Emit ANSI colors even when redirected
  --no-color             Disable colors (default: auto for terminals)
  --max-input-size N     Maximum input bytes (default 16777216)
  --max-depth N          Maximum child depth (default 64)
  --max-elements N       Maximum visited elements (default 100000)
  --search TEXT          tags: only tags whose name contains TEXT (case-insensitive)
  --value                query: print only the values of the addressed elements
  --tag HEX              encode: tag bytes in wire order
  --value HEX            encode: value bytes (default: empty)
  --output-encoding NAME encode: hex (default, one line) or binary
  --output-file PATH     encode: write the result to PATH instead of stdout
  --output-encoding NAME generate: bin (default) or json; one file per case
  --seed N               generate: explicit uint64 seed (zero is valid)
  --count N              generate: number of complete cases/files
  --output-dir PATH      generate: create directories; never overwrite case files
  --max-value-size N     generate: maximum Value bytes (default 256)
  --max-case-size N      generate: maximum case bytes (default 4096)
generate defaults: --max-depth 4, --max-elements 32; flat formats use depth 0.
decode prints the versioned JSON document that encode --input reads.
query prints every element addressed by a path of hexadecimal tags such as 6F/A5/50 (a top-level 6F, its child A5, its child 50); nested paths need --format ber or der. Exit code 5 means nothing matched.
tag looks up one BER tag in the EMV dictionary; an unknown tag is a result (exit 0), not an error; tags lists the dictionary.
completion prints a shell completion script to stdout for the given shell.
dump, validate, decode, query and encode (without --tag) read binary stdin when neither --input nor --hex (--tag for encode) is given, the same as --input -, so they compose in a shell pipeline; command output always goes to stdout and diagnostics to stderr.
Input is binary; hex accepts contiguous bytes or whitespace between pairs.
Validation accepts empty input and checks all concatenated elements.
With --module emv, validate also checks the EMV schema structure (mandatory/forbidden/duplicate tags, lengths, and nesting) and reports a schema-labeled diagnostic distinct from format errors; --pdol skips it.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 invalid TLV (or element rejected by encode), 2 invalid usage/hex/JSON/format, 3 I/O/resource error, 4 damaged data skipped by --recover.

completion-zsh.stdout:
#compdef otlv
# Install: otlv completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_otlv"
_otlv() {
    local -a commands
    commands=(dump validate decode encode generate query tag tags diff formats completion --help --version)
    if (( CURRENT == 2 )); then
        _describe 'command' commands
        return
    fi

    local cmd=${words[2]}
    local prev=${words[CURRENT-1]}
    local cur=${words[CURRENT]}

    case "$cmd" in
        completion)
            if (( CURRENT == 3 )); then
                local -a values; values=(bash zsh fish powershell)
                _describe 'value' values
                return
            fi
            ;;
    esac

    case "$prev" in
        --backend)
            local -a values; values=(auto streaming document)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
        --output-dir)
            _files
            return
            ;;
        --format)
            local -a values; values=(fixed emv ber der bluetooth-ltv nfc-type2)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
        --input)
            _files
            return
            ;;
        --module)
            local -a values; values=(emv bluetooth)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
        --input-encoding)
            local -a values; values=(binary hex)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
        --output)
            local -a values; values=(text json)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
        --output-encoding)
            local -a values
            case "$cmd" in
                encode) values=(binary hex);;
                generate) values=(bin json);;
            esac
            _describe 'value' values
            return ;;
        --emv-context)
            local -a values; values=(base bit bht bht-format bit-group biometric-counters biometric-attempts biometric-verification)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
        --emv-check)
            local -a values; values=(structure dictionary all)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
        --output-file)
            _files
            return
            ;;
        --diagnostics)
            local -a values; values=(human compact json)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
        --fixed-byte-order)
            local -a values; values=(big little)
            _describe 'value' values
            return
            ;;
    esac

    if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
        local -a opts
        case "$cmd" in
            dump) opts=(--tree --format --input --hex --max-input-size --max-depth --max-elements --pretty --describe --force-color --no-color --module --input-encoding --pdol --decode --output --recover --emv-context --diagnostics --fixed-tag-size --fixed-length-size --fixed-byte-order) ;;
            validate) opts=(--tree --format --input --hex --max-input-size --max-depth --max-elements --pretty --describe --force-color --no-color --module --input-encoding --pdol --decode --output --emv-context --emv-check --diagnostics --fixed-tag-size --fixed-length-size --fixed-byte-order) ;;
            decode) opts=(--format --input --hex --max-input-size --max-depth --max-elements --describe --module --input-encoding --decode --recover --emv-context --diagnostics --fixed-tag-size --fixed-length-size --fixed-byte-order) ;;
            encode) opts=(--format --input --max-input-size --max-depth --max-elements --tag --value --output-encoding --output-file --fixed-tag-size --fixed-length-size --fixed-byte-order) ;;
            generate) opts=(--seed --count --output-dir --max-value-size --max-case-size --format --max-depth --max-elements --output-encoding --fixed-tag-size --fixed-length-size --fixed-byte-order) ;;
            query) opts=(--exists --explain --var --backend --query --count --format --input --hex --max-input-size --max-depth --max-elements --input-encoding --output --value --diagnostics --fixed-tag-size --fixed-length-size --fixed-byte-order) ;;
            tag) opts=(--module --output) ;;
            tags) opts=(--module --output --search) ;;
            diff) opts=(--against --where --format --input --max-input-size --max-depth --max-elements --output --diagnostics --fixed-tag-size --fixed-length-size --fixed-byte-order) ;;
        esac
        _describe 'option' opts
    fi
}

_otlv "$@"
